definition: work done by one person that benefits another
description: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

de.answer: Er unterschreibt am Check-in-Schalter ein Dokument.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?
